resource.description: The route segment this resource is served under, e.g. "connections". Becomes ResourceName on the endpoint and the literal the client calls.

permission.description: The permission prefix the Crud base gates on, e.g. "connections" for connections:read.

referencePath.description: Relative path to FdwReferenceEndpoints.csproj, used only when projectReference is true.

projectReference.description: Reference FdwReferenceEndpoints by relative project path instead of by package. Use when generating inside the reference stack working tree.
